title: Samsung co-CEO TM Roh says the company has rolled out Gemini-powered AI features to ~400M mobile devices and aims to boost the figure to 800M in 2026 (Hyunjoo Jin/Reuters)
summary: Hyunjoo Jin / Reuters: Samsung co-CEO TM Roh says the company has rolled out Gemini-powered AI features to ~400M mobile devices and aims to boost the figure to 800M in 2026 — Samsung Electronics plans to double this year the number of its mobile devices with AI features powered by Google's Gemini, its co-CEO said …
